scope: Reconstructed regression suite; not a reproduction of the historical 344-check report. Full inline script executed in Node VM with lightweight DOM/canvas/timer mocks.

results.name: Emulator, provenance capture, and Save As/CHR blocks retain exact 1.6.2 bytes outside the declared correction delta
Complete application script initializes without an application error
CHR bitplanes roundtrip every pixel value and preserve bank offsets
Palette normalization shares universal background and clamps NES colors
Portable project roundtrip retains worlds, definitions, links, CHR, and animation
Legacy schema unversioned loads with absent worlds and valid empty metatile defaults
Legacy schema 2 loads with absent worlds and valid empty metatile defaults
Legacy schema 3 loads with absent worlds and valid empty metatile defaults
Legacy schema 4 loads with absent worlds and valid empty metatile defaults
Future schemas and malformed collections fail before replacing current project
Malformed map dimensions and unknown metatile references are rejected
Undo and redo restore project data including world destinations
New edits clear redo while history stays isolated from new project load
Metatile brush writes four nametable quadrants and survives serialization
Raw tile changes detach a mismatching metatile without changing its definition
World resize preserves coordinate positions and fills new area with empty cells
World creation selects an existing metatile scene when the active scene has no library
Assembler emits known 6502 bytes, labels, branches, strings, and vectors
Assembler reports out-of-range branches and undefined symbols
Default generated ROM has a valid NROM header, vectors, and Forge marker
Custom ASM occupying $C200 advances metadata placement and preserves code
Exhausted metadata space fails promptly with a capacity message
Missing interrupt vectors fail custom ROM generation
Build excludes unselected scenes and rejects a world using an excluded tileset
World-only metatiles fail preflight when their definition cannot be included in MT16
ROM re-import restores world coordinates, rooms, camera modes, and valid tileset references
ROM re-import keeps cross-world and same-world marker destinations resolvable
Generated scene viewer boots and produces nonempty framebuffer through actual emulator
iNES parser rejects bad signature, unsupported NES 2.0, and truncated image
Save As request and explicit cancellation produce no download
Native picker cancellation never triggers fallback browser download
Native save resolves successfully only after writable stream close completes
Writable close failure aborts stream, leaves Save As retryable, and never downloads
Explicit browser download is reported as requested, with sanitized filename
A concurrent Save As request cannot replace the pending export
Composer APIs and schema v6 initialize in the complete release
Composed project JSON preserves frame identities, pieces, origins, and animation bindings
Composed OAM conversion uses origin, palette, both flips, priority, and explicit lower tile
Metasprite pixels continue using their source scene after active scene changes
8x16 vertical flip swaps source tiles and reverses pixels around the authored anchor
OAM order wins opaque overlaps and transparent pixels leave later sprites visible
Hardware preview counts transparent OAM pieces toward eight sprites per scanline
Metasprite duplication and mirroring create new identities and reflect around the origin
Mixed-size scene OAM capture expands 8x16 pairs without losing their vertical flip
Animation sources switch through the actual commands and preserve legacy tile/duration
Animation frame bounds use the explicit origin and fixed union across composed and tile frames
Missing animation references survive editing with a visible missing-source result and block build
MS16 checksum and declared payload length reject corrupted bytes
MS16 links source tiles without mutating authoring IDs or unrelated sprite CHR
ROM import restores composed frames with new unique IDs and remapped animation references
Portable asset export contains complete frames and their sprite sources
Out-of-range authored coordinates and duplicate frame identities reject schema v6 load
